name: MONEI
line: Spanish payment gateway with checkout, links and recurring card payments.

free.text: No setup or monthly minimum; €0.15 per active day

cells.countries: Businesses registered in Spain and Andorra
cells.payout: 30-day first hold; then D+7 by default
